svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Saw 112 mm off 70 x 16 mm bar; saw and file the width

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to 63 mm. The 112 x 16 face is the back; file it flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a 90 degree V on both 112 x 63 faces with a 45 degree square:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 106 mm wide at the front face, point 10 mm from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw just inside both lines, file to the lines; keep the faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rebate each back corner 9 mm wide and 2 mm deep, full height:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the band passes under it. Round the front outer corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 14 mm lightening holes through: 15 mm from the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 37 mm each side, and 35 mm from the back at 45 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm, 14 deep, tap M4 12 deep in the back face at 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of centre, half way up (8 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M4 countersunk screws from the box side of the FieldNode

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back plate. A 114 mm pole touches both V faces 40 mm off centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 114 mm tube the block must not rock.
